title: lindernia elata
intro: Lindernia elata, commonly known as False Lipstick, is a plant species in the Linderniaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Africa, for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Lindernia elata include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in reducing pain and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of Lindernia elata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
